_comment: Hook commands use $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR so they resolve from anywhere.
A bare relative path ('python tools/hooks/bash_guard.py') resolves against the
SHELL's current directory, so a single `cd` into a subdirectory made every
subsequent Bash call fail with 'can't open file .../tools/hooks/bash_guard.py'
- the guard blocked the tool it was protecting, and the only way out was to
create a stub at the wrong path. Keep these absolute.
